Comments: Civil registration system is "essentially paper based with no consolidated database, decentralized" per World Bank 2023 diagnostic. Definition: Extent to which the national digital identity system is integrated with the data exchange for identity verification and authentication
Comments: In 2020, Chad introduced SIGPTS (integrated identity management system) managed by ANATS, providing unique National Identification Number (NIN) through National Biometric Registration Program (RNBP). However, two separate systems exist for civil registration (paper-based) and national ID card, requiring reforms. Integration with data exchange platform lacking. World Bank notes "existing government recognized legal identification systems require reforms to serve as foundation for digital service delivery.

Definition: Integration of health records, patient registration, immunization data, and health insurance into data exchange
Comments: Digital clinical decision support system (TRICC) piloted in refugee/rural health contexts with NGO support. Cloud server subscription required (government infrastructure insufficient for local server). Integration of CR services with health systems mentioned in WB project. No national health information system integrated with government data exchange.

Definition: Integration with national payment systems for government-to-person (G2P), government-to-business (G2B) transactions via data exchange
Comments: Digital payments infrastructure limited: "a shared government digital payments infrastructure is not available and the GoC makes limited use of digital means of payment." Some mobile money for community teachers and cash transfers. e-Tax and e-Tax modules launched from 2022 onward. Limited interoperability among mobile wallet providers.

Definition: Integration of tax administration and revenue collection systems data into the exchange platform
Comments: SIGFiP (Integrated Public Finance Management System), eTax application, and ASYCUDA World (customs) are operational back-office systems. e-Tax platform launched July 2022. e-registration and new e-Tax modules launched March and May 2023. However, these systems are siloed and not integrated through a common interoperability framework.

Definition: Whether a detailed implementation roadmap with phases, milestones, and timelines exists for data exchange development
Comments: Chad Connection 2030 plan is public but high-level. The World Bank Digital Transformation Project (P180000, 2024) includes sub-component on strategies for digitalization of selected sectors. World Bank Digital Economy Diagnostic noted need for "sequenced strategic action plans." A formal published roadmap with phases and milestones for data exchange is under development as part of WB project.

Definition: Current operational status of the data exchange system
Comments: No unified government data exchange/interoperability platform exists. World Bank Digital Transformation Project (P180000, approved September 2024, $246M) explicitly states "there are no end user-facing transactional digital services" and back-office systems "have been developed in a siloed approach which limits interoperability." ADETIC is making progress in interconnecting ministries but most government offices lack ability to exchange data through a secure network. The national data center (with 100 micro-data centers) is being secured/certified as of February 2026 - planned/early development.

Definition: Extent to which the data exchange enables services accessible to all population groups including persons with disabilities, elderly, low literacy
Comments: No e-government services accessible to citizens. No end user-facing transactional digital services as of 2023 WB diagnostic. Only 13.2% of population has internet access (2025). Digital literacy gaps prevalent among public servants and citizens.

Chapter Details: The architecture, governance, functionality and uptake of government data exchange systems. 25 variables in 4 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: Provisions ensuring national control over government data and protecting against unauthorized foreign access
Comments: National data center under construction/certification (2026). 100 micro data centers planned for government institutions. Personal data protection law (No. 007/PR/2015) exists. However, World Bank notes the framework is "not yet fully applied." Government notes growing cybercrime challenges. Data hosting infrastructure being built nationally but not yet operational.

Chapter Details: The architecture, governance, functionality and uptake of government data exchange systems. 25 variables in 4 sections. Contains latest available data. Data collection by Perplexity from a variety of sources.
Definition: Extent to which provincial/state and local governments participate in the data exchange
Comments: ADETIC progress in interconnecting ministries and providing basic connectivity exists. 100 micro data centers planned for government institutions (2026). But most government offices lack broadband and the ability to exchange data. No sub-national participation in a data exchange framework. Chad ranked 189/193 on EGDI.

Definition: Whether data exchange infrastructure and services reach rural and remote areas or concentrate in urban centers
Comments: Only 13.2% internet access nationally (2025), with sharp urban-rural disparities. Digital transformation efforts concentrated in N'Djamena. Tchad Connexion 2030 aims to expand rural coverage but not yet implemented.
